description: Dark navy long wool coat with cream-gold geometric embroidery along the front, cuffs and hem, cream embroidered long shirt underneath, decorated brown leather belt with metal medallions and hanging end, dark trousers and brown leather boots. Textured brown fur runs along the front collar edges, cuffs and lower hem; more extensive than subtle trim. Both hands hang visibly beside the coat and complete hair, beard and boots are inside the frame. No headgear, armor, weapons or text.
